description: Stat definitions as the iOS app computes them today. Rows use the column names of docs/design/1.1-sync.md section 2. See README.md for the rules behind each field.

conventions.ratios: Fractions 0..1, shown as percentages. null means the app shows '--' or hides the stat.
conventions.live_rows: Rows with deleted_at set, and hands whose session has deleted_at set, are never inputs (design 9.1). purged rows are removed by then.
conventions.completed: A session counts toward money stats only when status is exactly 'completed'. Abandoned sessions are completed with cash_out 0.
conventions.hand_scope: Lifetime hand stats use every live hand, including hands of active and non-completed sessions.
conventions.time: now and time_zone are inputs: an open session's duration uses now; the 30-day window keeps rows at or after now minus 30 days (the app subtracts 30 calendar days in the device calendar, the fixtures use 30 x 86400 s and do not cross a DST change); weekdays use time_zone.
conventions.numbers: IEEE 754 doubles, summed in the order the rows appear. Compare to the expected values with a relative tolerance of 1e-9.

hands_folded.formula: count(preflop_action = fold OR (faced_3bet AND three_bet_response = folded))

cbet.formula: count(opportunity AND did_cbet = true) / count(opportunity), opportunity = preflop_action = raise AND saw_flop

wtsd.formula: count(saw_flop AND showdown) / count(saw_flop); saw_flop = postflop_result not null and not wonPreflop; showdown = postflop_result in [wonAtShowdown, lostAtShowdown]

play_style.formula: VPIP/PFR bands: vpip < 0.12 Nit; < 0.18 Rock if pfr/vpip > 0.6 else Passive; <= 0.30 TAG if pfr/vpip > 0.6 else Passive; <= 0.45 LAG if pfr/vpip > 0.5 else Fish; else Maniac if pfr > 0.30 else Fish

total_profit.formula: sum over completed sessions of net_profit

hours.formula: sum over completed sessions of duration_hours

session_counts_toward_money_stats.formula: status = completed (an unknown status decodes as active, Session.swift:17)

session_net_profit.formula: cash_out - (buy_in + rebuys + add_ons); tip_rake is not subtracted

session_roi.source: PokerStats/Models/Session.swift:74-77; shown only for completed sessions, SessionDetailView.swift:196

per_position.formula: for each of SB, BB, UTG, UTG+1, LJ, MP, HJ, CO, BTN in that order with at least one hand: hand_count, vpip, pfr over that position's hands. '?' and unknown positions are left out
per_position.null_when: a position with no hands is omitted

cumulative_bankroll.formula: completed sessions sorted by start_time; a first point (start_time of the first, 0, index 0), then one point per session (end_time ?? start_time, running net_profit total, index i+1)

rolling_vpip_pfr.formula: hands sorted by played_at; for each window of 20 consecutive hands ending at hand i (1-based): vpip and pfr over the window

profit_by_day_of_week.formula: always 7 entries Sun..Sat (day_number 1..7); completed sessions grouped by the weekday of start_time in the device time zone (dataset time_zone)

pl_distribution.formula: completed net_profit values in buckets of 100 from floor(min/100)*100 up to floor(max/100)*100 + 100, each [lower, lower+100), so the maximum is always in the last bucket. Labels +$N for N >= 0, -$N below

mental_correlation.formula: for each metric (energy, focus, tilt) and level: average of session hourly_rate over completed sessions with that level and a non-null hourly_rate; sorted by metric name, then level

mental_insight.formula: calm = tilt level 1 point; tilted = first tilt point with level >= 4 in level order; both need session_count >= 2
mental_insight.null_when: either point missing or below 2 sessions

leak_finder.formula: for each profile (six_max is the dashboard default; full_ring is selectable) and each stat in vpip, pfr, cbet, fold_to_3bet, wtsd, wsd with a non-null value: healthy inside the closed ideal range, borderline inside the closed acceptable range, else leak. Overall: Leaking if 2+ leaks, Needs Work if 1 leak or 2+ borderline, else Solid. Ranges are in leak_profiles.

widget.formula: total_profit, sessions_played and hourly_rate as the lifetime money stats; current_streak = number of completed sessions, newest start_time first, with net_profit > 0 before the first that is not

displays.label: String as given.
displays.ratings: Rating names healthy, borderline, leak; overall Solid, Needs Work, Leaking.
displays.percent: value * 100 rounded half even to 1 decimal, then '%'. null is '--'. PokerStats/Models/ComputedStats.swift:58-61
displays.currency: en_US currency, whole dollars, half even: $1,234 and -$567. PokerStats/Models/ComputedStats.swift:64-70, PokerStats/Utilities/CurrencyFormatter.swift:21-23
displays.currency_signed: '+' for >= 0, '-' below, then the whole-dollar currency of the absolute value. PokerStats/Utilities/CurrencyFormatter.swift:31-38
displays.hourly_rate: en_US currency with 2 decimals, half even, then '/hr'. null is '--'. PokerStats/Models/ComputedStats.swift:73-81
displays.widget_currency: '-' below 0 else '+', '$', then the absolute value truncated to an integer, with thousands separators from 1000. PokerStatsWidgets/PokerStatsLifetimeWidget.swift:189-196
